name: Passive Pass Over Development
description: V4 selects PASS/DONE when legal ATTACH or EVOLVE was available in hand
alternative_action: Execute available ATTACH or EVOLVE before ending turn

name: Over-Saturation on Saturated Active
description: V4 attaches 4th+ energy to active when bench has 0 energy, leaving bench empty upon active KO
alternative_action: Diversify attachment to secondary bench attacker once active reaches 3-4 energy

name: Delayed Knockout Execution
description: V4 attaches energy instead of immediately executing legal attack against lethal target (<=40HP)
alternative_action: Execute immediate lethal ATTACK to take prize card and deny opponent turn

name: Zero-Bench Vulnerability
description: Playing mid-game with 0 benched Pokémon, exposing player to instant match loss on active KO
alternative_action: Prioritize basic Pokémon bench placement during setup and early turns

name: Evolution Delay on Low-HP Basic
description: V4 attaches energy instead of evolving threatened basic Pokémon to expand HP pool above lethal range
alternative_action: Evolve active to Stage 1/2 immediately when current HP is within opponent 1HKO threshold
